title: Datadog notebook
summary: A Datadog notebook drawn from its snapshot under evidence/datadog/: the header names the notebook, links to Datadog and states when the snapshot was taken and what window it covers; markdown cells render as prose, timeseries cells as uPlot charts with the outage windows and timestamps painted over them, toplists as horizontal bars, log streams as a table, and cells with no snapshot data as a card carrying the query. The page renders one collapsible block per evidence.notebooks entry in Evidence, the first open; declare one to place a subset of cells beside the cause they prove.
belongs: Evidence by default; a declared subset belongs on the cause card it proves, or in Detection next to the monitor that missed it.

title.description: replaces the notebook's own name in the header

notebook.description: the id of an evidence.notebooks entry

cells.description: cell indexes to draw; default every cell

height.description: chart height in CSS pixels; default 220

bands.description: paint windows and timestamps over each chart; default true
